properties.description: Length fields must be read before value extraction begins
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: MODEXP_CALL. extract_values(call) => lengths_parsed(call.base_len, call.exp_len, call.mod_len)
properties.rationale: Lengths determine byte offsets for value extraction

properties.description: Input parsing extracts lengths from first 96 bytes in specific order
properties.formal_spec: FORALL input: CALLDATA. base_len = bytes(0-31) AND exp_len = bytes(32-63) AND mod_len = bytes(64-95)
properties.rationale: Fixed format ensures deterministic parsing across implementations

properties.description: Values extracted starting at offset 96 with declared lengths
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: MODEXP_CALL. base = bytes(96, base_len) AND exp = bytes(96+base_len, exp_len) AND mod = bytes(96+base_len+exp_len, mod_len)
properties.rationale: Contiguous layout after length headers

properties.description: Gas cost minimum is 200 regardless of input
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: MODEXP_CALL. gas_cost(call) >= 200
properties.rationale: Minimum prevents zero-cost abuse of precompile

properties.description: Gas cost scales with multiplication complexity and iteration count
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: MODEXP_CALL. gas_cost(call) = max(200, (complexity(call) * iterations(call)) / 3)
properties.rationale: EIP-2565 formula reflects actual computational work

properties.description: Insufficient gas must cause out-of-gas failure
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: MODEXP_CALL. available_gas < gas_cost(call) => out_of_gas(call)
properties.rationale: Gas metering prevents DoS attacks

properties.description: Gas must be charged before computation begins
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: MODEXP_CALL. compute_powmod(call) => gas_charged(call)
properties.rationale: Gas payment required before resource consumption

properties.description: Zero modulus must return all-zero bytes of mod_length
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: MODEXP_CALL. modulus == 0 AND base != 0 => output == zeros(mod_length)
properties.rationale: Division by zero handled gracefully with zeros

properties.description: Both base and modulus zero must return empty bytes
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: MODEXP_CALL. modulus == 0 AND base == 0 => output == empty
properties.rationale: Special edge case with empty output

properties.description: Output must be padded to mod_length bytes
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: MODEXP_CALL. modulus != 0 => length(output) == mod_length
properties.rationale: Fixed output length expected by callers

properties.description: Short input is zero-padded to declared lengths
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: MODEXP_CALL. length(input) < required_length => values_zero_padded(call)
properties.rationale: Graceful handling of incomplete input

properties.description: Mana opcodes have identical semantics to former gas opcodes
properties.formal_spec: FORALL opcode: MANA_OPCODE. semantics(opcode) == semantics(corresponding_gas_opcode(opcode))
properties.rationale: Renaming is purely terminological with no functional change

properties.description: MANA opcode pushes remaining mana to stack
properties.formal_spec: FORALL exec: MANA_EXEC. execute(exec) => stack.push(remaining_mana(exec.context))
properties.rationale: Contracts can check available resources

properties.description: Call mana input must be validated before allocation
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: CALL_OP. allocate_mana(call) => validated_mana_input(call)
properties.rationale: Invalid mana values could cause unexpected behavior

properties.description: eth_estimateMana returns same values as former eth_estimateGas
properties.formal_spec: FORALL tx: TRANSACTION. eth_estimateMana(tx) == eth_estimateGas(tx)
properties.rationale: RPC renaming is purely terminological

properties.description: eth_manaPrice returns same values as former eth_gasPrice
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request: RPC_REQUEST. eth_manaPrice() == eth_gasPrice()
properties.rationale: RPC renaming is purely terminological

properties.description: manaleft() returns same value as former gasleft()
properties.formal_spec: FORALL context: EXECUTION_CONTEXT. manaleft(context) == gasleft(context)
properties.rationale: Language binding renaming is purely terminological

properties.description: Contracts can validate sufficient mana before operations
properties.formal_spec: FORALL check: MANA_CHECK. mana_sufficient(check) => can_continue_execution(check)
properties.rationale: Mana checking enables resource-aware contract logic

properties.description: Input must be parsed before validation begins
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: ECRECOVER_CALL. validate_params(call) => input_parsed(call.hash, call.v, call.r, call.s)
properties.rationale: Validation requires extracted signature components

properties.description: Recovery ID v must be exactly 27 or 28
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: ECRECOVER_CALL. valid_v(call) <=> call.v IN {27, 28}
properties.rationale: Only two valid recovery IDs for secp256k1

properties.description: r value must be in range (0, SECP256K1N)
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: ECRECOVER_CALL. valid_r(call) <=> 0 < call.r < SECP256K1N
properties.rationale: r outside curve order is mathematically invalid

properties.description: s value must be in range (0, SECP256K1N)
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: ECRECOVER_CALL. valid_s(call) <=> 0 < call.s < SECP256K1N
properties.rationale: s outside curve order is mathematically invalid

properties.description: Invalid signature parameters must return empty output
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: ECRECOVER_CALL. NOT valid_v(call) OR NOT valid_r(call) OR NOT valid_s(call) => output == empty
properties.rationale: Silent failure for invalid inputs

properties.description: Recovery failure must return empty output
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: ECRECOVER_CALL. recovery_throws_error(call) => output == empty
properties.rationale: Silent failure for cryptographic errors

properties.description: Successful recovery returns 32-byte left-padded address
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: ECRECOVER_CALL. recovery_success(call) => output == left_pad(address(call), 32)
properties.rationale: 20-byte address padded to 32 bytes with zeros

properties.description: Address derived from keccak256 of recovered public key
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: ECRECOVER_CALL. address(call) == last_20_bytes(keccak256(public_key(call)))
properties.rationale: Standard Ethereum address derivation

properties.description: Validation must check v before r before s
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: ECRECOVER_CALL. validate(call) => check_v BEFORE check_r BEFORE check_s
properties.rationale: Ordered validation for early rejection

properties.description: ECRECOVER has fixed gas cost of 3000
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: ECRECOVER_CALL. gas_cost(call) == 3000
properties.rationale: Fixed cost per EIP specification

properties.description: Insufficient gas causes out-of-gas failure
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: ECRECOVER_CALL. available_gas < 3000 => out_of_gas(call)
properties.rationale: Gas metering prevents resource exhaustion

properties.description: Empty return for invalid signature is not address(0)
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: ECRECOVER_CALL. output == empty <=> NOT EXISTS recovered_address(call)
properties.rationale: Callers must check for empty vs address(0) to avoid vulnerabilities

notes: Batch 20 covers three specifications: Cancun MODEXP precompile (modular exponentiation with EIP-2565 gas formula), EIP-6789 (gas-to-mana terminology renaming with identical semantics), and Cancun ECRECOVER precompile (ECDSA signature recovery). Critical properties ensure correct input parsing, gas charging before computation, validation of cryptographic parameters, and proper handling of edge cases like zero modulus or invalid signatures.
